_about: Hand labels for the recall eval, judged against the frozen memory snapshot in state/evals/memory (index.jsonl and tickets/ both hold #29, #32, #46, #53, #74, #123, #179, #193). No two runs in it share a file, so no case has a `must` yet: every overlap is module-level or weaker, which the skill treats as real but optional. must = has to be cited; ok = may be cited; anything else cited fails. Re-label after `npm run eval -- recall --refresh-memory`.
